title: Post to 5 platforms from one Claude Code chat.
lead: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube and X from one message. Claude Code writes a caption for each platform and posts or schedules through Zernio, after you approve.
inside: Connect your accounts to Zernio, plug its MCP into Claude Code, and run the prompts that write per-platform captions and post or schedule them.
what: Zernio (the social media API formerly called Late) connects your social accounts once and gives Claude Code a hosted MCP server for posting, scheduling and analytics across 15+ networks.

You give Claude the video and the idea. It writes a native caption for each platform, shows you the drafts, then posts or schedules them. No scheduler app, no copy-pasting the same caption five times.
prereqs: A Zernio account (the first 2 connected accounts are free)
Business or Creator Instagram (linked to a Facebook page), plus TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube and X logins
warn: Zernio really publishes. A wrong caption, a broken link or a 3 AM schedule goes live on every platform at once. Always ask for drafts first and approve before Claude posts. Beyond 2 accounts Zernio charges per connected account, so check current pricing.

steps.p: Sign up at zernio.com/signup. The first 2 connected accounts are free, enough to test the whole flow before you connect all five.
In the Zernio dashboard, connect each account. Instagram needs a Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook page.
steps.code:
1. Instagram   (Business/Creator account, needs a linked FB page)
2. TikTok      (Personal or Business both work)
3. LinkedIn    (Personal profile OR company page, your call)
4. YouTube     (Channel auth via Google)
5. X           (OAuth, takes ~10 seconds)

steps.p: Dashboard, then API Keys, then create a key. Keep it private: anyone with it can post as you.
Paste this in your terminal with your key, then restart Claude Code. Test it by asking: List my connected Zernio accounts.
steps.code: claude mcp add zernio https://mcp.zernio.com --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ZERNIO_API_KEY"

prompts.code:
Here's my video: [file]. The idea: [one line].
Write a native caption for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts and X.
Keep my voice, end each with [CTA]. Show me all five drafts. Don't post anything yet.

Post the approved drafts through Zernio to all five accounts now.
List each platform with the post link when done.

Schedule the approved drafts for tomorrow at 9 AM my time on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube.
Skip X. Confirm the schedule back to me before you send it.

Pull my last 30 days of posts from Zernio analytics. Find the 3 with the best engagement
and draft fresh captions to repost them next week. Show me before scheduling.
